metadata.title: Saraswati Pipeline v3.0.0
metadata.subtitle: Intelligence & Global Scale · 19 tasks · Phase V

tasks.label: AMP Governance
tasks.description: Resolve open AMPs from Phase IV before Phase V begins

tasks.label: Federated Learning: Core Infrastructure
tasks.description: Phase V.1: Federated averaging, secure aggregation (MPC), differential privacy (ε<0.10), cross-tenant training convergence monitoring

tasks.label: Federated Learning: Privacy & Validation
tasks.description: Phase V.1: Privacy audit (no reconstruction), convergence benchmarks (within 5% of centralized model), federated monitoring dashboard

tasks.label: Predictive Astrology: Transformer Model
tasks.description: Phase V.2: Time-series transformer for transit predictions, personal event prediction (trained on birth-death datasets), confidence intervals

tasks.label: Predictive Astrology: Validation
tasks.description: Phase V.2: Gold-standard prediction tests (withheld events), Brier score calibration, human expert comparison study, limitations disclosure

tasks.label: Community Knowledge Graph: Contribution System
tasks.description: Phase V.3: KG contribution workflow (expert submit → peer review → merge), graph visualization explorer, citation tracking

tasks.label: Community Knowledge Graph: Trust & Reputation
tasks.description: Phase V.3: Expert reputation system, vandalism detection, merge conflict resolution, per-node versioning, trust model

tasks.label: Global Compute Grid: Scaling
tasks.description: Phase V.4: Kubernetes cluster autoscaling, spot/preemptible instances + job checkpointing, regional sharding (EU→EU, US→US)

tasks.label: Global Compute Grid: CDN & Cost
tasks.description: Phase V.4: CDN for charts/reports, cost optimization (target $0.014/chart), 1M chart computation benchmark

tasks.label: Ethics & Governance: Provenance
tasks.description: Phase V.5: Content provenance tracking (chart→calculation→model→input), audit trails for AI outputs, data lineage

tasks.label: Ethics & Governance: AI Safety Board
tasks.description: Phase V.5: AI Safety policy, human Oversight Board, prediction scope limits, classical knowledge curation policy, bias audit

tasks.label: Partnerships: API & White-Label
tasks.description: Phase V.6: Partner API (licensing, white-label, custom branding), embeddable widgets (chart, transit), SSO federation, revenue-sharing settlement

tasks.label: Knowledge: Classical Data Curation
tasks.description: Phase V.5 curation: define acceptable prediction scope (astrology), curate prediction-relevant texts (Gochara, Prana Phala, Tajik), bias audit across traditions

tasks.label: Benchmark: Federated & Predictive Models
tasks.description: Phase V.1+V.2 benchmark: Federated model convergence vs centralized, prediction model accuracy (target >65%), Brier score <0.30, user study with experts

tasks.label: QA: Distributed Systems Chaos Engineering
tasks.description: Phase V QA. Multi-region failover, distributed compute stress test, spot instance preemption recovery, provenance audit (full chain traced)

tasks.label: Security: Global Infrastructure Audit
tasks.description: Phase V security. Cross-region pen-test, federated node compromise simulation, AI model output poisoning detection, content provenance audit

tasks.label: Documentation: Full Platform Handbook
tasks.description: Phase V docs. SaaS deployment guide, federated learning setup, predictive model integration guide, partner API docs, AI ethics handbook

tasks.label: Release: v3.0.0 Tag, GA Declaration
tasks.description: v3.0.0 Release. Git tag v3.0.0, federated learning published, prediction engine GA, knowledge graph community launches, partner ecosystem live, migration guide v2.4→v3.0, changelog

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Global SaaS Launch
tasks.description: Phase V.6. SaaS GA launch with 3 regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1), partner APIs made available, global CDN configured, monitoring dashboard live

M5: Federated learning: Model trained across 5+ tenants, quality within 5% of centralized baseline
Predictive accuracy: >65% correctness on benchmark, Brier score <0.30
Knowledge Graph: 100+ expert contributions, under 1% vandalism rate
Global compute: 1M charts processed in distributed grid at <$0.014 per chart
AI governance: Oversight Board established, provenance tracking at 100% coverage
Partnerships: 5+ formal partners, revenue-sharing settlement active
